object.name: evi.lockhart.simple~
object.digest: Anti-aliased wavefolder device for shaping oscillators, simultaneous outputs up to four stages
object.description: An analog model of the 'Lockhart Wavefolder' employing antiderivative anti-aliasing via Lambert-W functions. The waveshaper takes a simple audio signal and aggressively folds and clips it to produce new shapes and harmonics in the style of west coast synthesis. This 'simple' version has a fixed cascade for four simultaneous outputs of 4 stages, 3 stages, 2 stages or 1 stage. See <o>evi.lockhart.cascade~</o> for a version with more options.
object.discussion: Based on the paper: 'Virtual Analog Model of the Lockhart Wavefolder' by Fabian Esqueda, Henri Pontynen, Julian D. Parker, Stefan Bilbao, SMC, 2017.

inlets.description: Audio input to be wavefolded, typically a simple oscillator.
